Approved: discard answers on page/competition change and session exit; lock evaluated answers on current page; retain choice and retry after submission failure. Small-screen sidebar collapsible. Ten questions per page. Open: question ordering, empty sidebar, exact responsive treatment, uncertain submission outcomes.
Approved: Ghost navigation trigger in all workspace states, including desktop. Sidebar collapse retains current page and answers. Phone layout and navigation loading/failure are proposed studies; exact breakpoint, drawer behavior and data recovery remain open.
